verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the 'flex' service tier: a 20% discount on Chat Completions in exchange for slower responses, which the docs pitch for asynchronous workloads such as data enrichment and model evaluations. That makes large-volume processing cheaper, but each item is still sent as its own request. No dedicated batch endpoint or bulk submission mechanism is documented. Missing for 10: a batch/bulk API for submitting many items in one job, job status and result retrieval, multi-input request support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
